messages:
nora: heads-up, nightly integ smoke turned red on hosted. auth+stream+toolcall failing on shard 12. run: https://ci.internal/runs/1712345600

ci-bot: Run 1712345600 — FAILED on shard 12. artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/1712345600

sam: joining — which test is blowing up?

nora: hosted_integration::toolcall_path::schema_assert. validator expects `tool_output.meta.release` but response only has `tool_output.info` with `ver` key. snippet below.

sam: paste of captured body:
```
{"session":"s-42","tool_output":{"data":"...","info":{"ver":"1.0","time":168000}}}
```
(expected `meta.release`)

ida: sounds like a serialization rename in the tool bridge. any recent pushes from tools team?

nora: not on infra deploys list. model catalog auto-rolled a beta yesterday morning though. rachel — can you queue a shard-only rerun with capture? use HTTP_CAPTURE=1.

rachel: rerun queued: `ci retry --run 1712345600 --shard 12` — capturing full responses.

dev-bot: Retry started (job 1712345621) for run 1712345600 shard 12

mike: flagging this — if smoke is unstable we block tonight's cut. fallback plan ready to pin smoke to model v1.8 if needed.

sam: rerun finished, still failing. artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/1712345621 — looks consistently returning `info.ver` not `meta.release`.

ida: starting a bisection across 1712344000..1712345600. first bad commit looks like 1712345110 which touches tool-adapter proto and serializer.

tools-bot: @tools-team pinged for commit 1712345110 (possible proto rename).

tools-janet: on it, checking whether a proto rename landed. if so we can add a compatibility shim in the adapter within a patch release. will update INF-5012.

rachel: crafting a minimal curl repro that hits the same hosted path and saving request/response for the tools team.

nora: created ticket INF-5012 to track triage + mitigation (artifacts + bisection). https://tracker.internal/INF-5012

mike: mitigation options: (1) quick adapter shim to translate `info.ver` -> `meta.release` during smoke, (2) pin model/runtime variant for smoke to last-known-good, (3) rollback the tool-adapter commit if needed. prioritize low-risk option 1 for immediate cut.

sam: agree. if tools team can ship a small compatibility wrapper, that should be fastest. leo (cc) can you help with the canary if we need to pin the model?

ida: bisection confirms 1712345110 as first bad. adding diff to INF-5012 and tagging tools-janet.

tools-janet: confirmed proto rename slipped into adapter change. prepping a small backwards-compatible serializer now — ETA ~45m. will push to canary and link artifact.

nora: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll hold the release window for 1h and monitor INF-5012. please add any extra logs to the ticket. closing thread for async follow-ups.
